## Smooth Image Loading **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/smooth-image-loading/>

**Location: **Appearance → Customize → Additional→ Optimization → Smooth Image Loading

Smooth Image Loading is a process of loading an image in a way that appears smoothly without any noticeable delay or visual disruption.

ColorMag theme comes with the Smooth Image Loading feature and provides the following options:

**Enable:** In order to enable the Smooth Image Loading, toggle the option to the right side. Once it is enabled, it will allow you to change the animation effect while the image is being loaded on your end. The transition option is listed below:

- Fade In – Fade In animation refers to the visual effect where the image becomes visually by slowly increasing its opacity, creating a smooth transition.

- Fade In Down – Fade In Down refers to the visual effect where the image becomes visual and moves slowly downward.

- Fade In Up – Fade In Up refers to the visual effect where the image becomes visual and moves slowly upward.

## Integrate External APIs **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/integrate-external-apis/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Additional → Integrations →

With the ColorMag theme, you can integrate the site with external APIs. You can add the **API keys** to display the following options on your site.

- **OpenWeatherMap API Key**: Add current & forecast weather data collection to your site.

- **GoogleMaps API Key**: Add Google Maps to your website

- **Exchange Rate API Key:** Add exchange rates and currency conversion data to your site

## Manage Schema Markup **Pro**

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/schema-markup-in-colormag/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Additional → General → Schema Markup

Under General , Check the Enable checkbox to enable the Schema Markup.

## Manage Social Icons

<https://docs.themegrill.com/colormag/docs/social-icons/>

Location: Appearance → Customize → Additional → Social Icons

## Social Icons

### Enable

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the** Social Icons** on your site. Enabling the option will display the social link areas as well social icons on various areas.

## Position

With the ColorMag theme, you can change the location/position of the social media icons under the following sections.

### **Header **

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the** Social Icons** on the header area. Under the header area you can choose the social icon to be display in the **Top Bar** or **Menu** area.

### **Footer **

Switch the Toggle to the right area to enable the** Social Icons** on the footer area Enabling the option will display the social icons on the footer areas.

## Add Social Links

Under each social icon name, you can add the respective link where it redirects to the social media page. Also, if you want to open the social page on a new tab check the box Check to open in new tab and publish the changes.

## Available Social Icons

ColorMag themes come with various social icons by default. Below is the list of the Social Icons available in the ColorMag theme:

#### Available in Free and Pro Version

- Facebook

- Twitter

- Google-Plus

- Instagram

- Pinterest

- YouTube

#### Available in Pro Version

- Vimeo-Square

- LinkedIn

- Delicious

- Flickr

- Skype

- SoundCloud

- Vine

- StumbleUpon

- Tumblr

- Reddit

- Xing

- VK
